name: InforMEA API
description: Tools to expose content via REST for the InforMEA platform.
project_description:
InforMEA API module 
 This module contains a set of REST plugins which can be used to create REST-based API endpoints to epose data into the format required by the InforMEA project.

 This process involves creating a view with the "InforMEA serializer" format plugin for each content type you want to expose. Additionally, when adding fields to the view, use the serializable versions of the fields (e.g. Title (serializable)).

 More information about the InforMEA project at https://www.informea.org/en/about/api 

 More information on how to use the module: Module documentation
